root.meaning: Declared physical blade start of this study layout; independent of the 90 mm hub radius and 144 mm first aerodynamic station

budget.cell_order: Mach ascending, then Reynolds ascending; cold process per cell, ALFA ascending
budget.stop: Stop after any incomplete, timeout, execution, provenance or persistence failure. No retry, fallback, cell substitution or re-gridding; a failed cell is retained and ends this protocol version.

relation_to_v1: Separate family per profile; same executable, settings and angle sequence as deploy-v3.
scope: Attached-flow NACA4415 section grid for the 800 mm research layout. Unqualified numerical evidence; more XFOIL coverage does not establish validity in separated flow.
grid_selection: Levels chosen from the convergence pre-screen of this executable with the shifted sequence (reports/catalog_polars_20261116/convergence_prescreen_high_camber_shifted.json).

failed_declarations.outcome: stopped at cell index 1: CL(-4 deg) >= 0 (zero-lift angle near -4 deg) violates the retained lift-sign rule
